schema.description: One file in a documents library: a pointer to the bytes, which stay in the library and never enter the ledger. Written by the documents source (the default library beside the ledger, or a declared one), from the file itself and its .meta.yaml sidecar.

bytes.description: The file's size in bytes, measured by the documents worker when it reads the file. Not from the sidecar, which may not set it.

date.description: The document's own date (not the day it was scanned or filed), the sidecar's date key, as YYYY-MM-DD in Sydney. Required: a file without it refuses the scan. This is the fact time.

media_type.description: The media type the worker names from the file's extension, parameters stripped; the bytes are not sniffed. application/octet-stream when the extension is unknown. Not from the sidecar.

note.description: The sidecar's note key, free text written by whoever filed the document, verbatim.

path.description: The file's path relative to the library root, with forward slashes; it may include subfolders. The root itself never enters the fact. This is the identity, so a renamed file is a new facet.

sha256.description: SHA-256 of the file's bytes as lower-case hex, computed by the worker. Changed bytes at the same path supersede the facet.

title.description: The sidecar's title key, free text written by whoever filed the document, verbatim.
